title: The coaches want an extra session
text: A heavy week on the track, or a week to freshen up?

choices.label: Heavy session
choices.result: A heavy week on the track. The legs will know about it on game day.

choices.label: Recovery week
choices.result: A recovery week: fresher bodies and minds.

title: {name} is pushing for games
text: The kid's flying at training and wants a senior game.

choices.label: Back him for {run_games} games
choices.note: Nothing develops a player like AFL footy.

choices.label: A week with the development coaches
choices.note: It doesn't take a spot in the side, but there's no game for him at all this week.
choices.result: {name} spends the week with the development coaches.

title: {name} wants extra goalkicking after training
text: He's been staying back with the forwards coach most nights. The fitness staff would rather he went home.

choices.label: Let him stay back

effects.why: You let him put in the extra work

choices.result: {name} stays back with the forwards coach again.

choices.label: Send him home
choices.result: {name} is sent home with the rest of them.

title: Match sim got heated
text: Two of the boys had to be pulled apart at match sim. The assistants reckon it's the edge you've been after.

choices.label: Leave it on the track
choices.result: It stays on the track. The board hears about it anyway.

choices.label: Pull the group up on it
choices.result: You pull the group up. The standard is set.

title: The senior players want a day off
text: The leaders have asked for Monday off after a long block. The fitness staff are split.

choices.label: Give them the day
choices.result: Monday off. Fresh legs on Saturday.

choices.label: We train Monday
choices.result: Monday's on. A few long faces.

stakes: A day off costs the week's extra development.

title: The fitness staff want a time trial
text: A two-kilometre time trial in the middle of the season. It tells you who's fit; nobody loves it.

choices.label: Run it
choices.result: The time trial's done. Best over the two k: {best3}. Off the pace: {worst2}.

choices.label: Not this week
choices.result: No time trial. The group's relieved.

title: The midfield coach wants a new stoppage set-up
text: He's been working on it for weeks and wants the whole of Thursday to drill it.

choices.label: Stick with what we know
choices.result: The set-up stays in the drawer for now.

title: {name} has taken his chance
text: You gave him his run and he's grabbed it. The other kids have noticed.

choices.label: Tell him he's earned his spot

effects.why: You told him he'd earned his spot

choices.label: Keep his feet on the ground

title: {name} is finding senior footy hard
text: You backed him for a run of games. It's been tough going.

choices.label: Back him in for another week

effects.why: You kept backing him when it was hard

choices.label: Send him back to build in the twos

effects.why: You sent him back to the twos
